svg.title: Parametric 43-fin heat sink
svg.desc: Dimension-driven preview of the same idealized solid exported as STEP. Length 388.6, width 179.5, fin height 41, base 6, fin thickness 1.11 millimetres. A duct lid is assumed for flow analysis and is not shown or included in solid mass.

g.text: Idealized reference geometry · millimetres · not a manufacturing drawing
